title: Woman’s death triggers protest at K.R. Nagar hospital

ai.summary: Family members protested at K.R. Nagar Maternal and Child Health Hospital after a woman died following childbirth, alleging negligence. This is the second such death reported at the hospital in a month.

facts.claim: Death of a woman after she gave birth to a child at the Maternal and Child Health Hospital in K.R. Nagar on Thursday triggered a protest by her family members, who alleged negligence by the hospital authorities.
facts.quote: Death of a woman after she gave birth to a child at the Maternal and Child Health Hospital in K.R. Nagar on Thursday triggered a protest by her family members, who alleged negligence by the hospital authorities.

facts.claim: The deceased was identified as Sheelavathi, wife of Manjunath and a resident of K.R. Nagar taluk.
facts.quote: The deceased was identified as Sheelavathi, wife of Manjunath and a resident of K.R. Nagar taluk.

facts.claim: Following the delivery pain, she was admitted to the hospital on Tuesday and subsequently gave birth to a child on Thursday after Caesarian.
facts.quote: Following the delivery pain, she was admitted to the hospital on Tuesday and subsequently gave birth to a child on Thursday after Caesarian.

facts.claim: She had also undergone birth control operation, according to her family sources.
facts.quote: She had also undergone birth control operation, according to her family sources.

facts.claim: After delivery, she reportedly suffered severe bleeding and subsequently developed medical complications.
facts.quote: After delivery, she reportedly suffered severe bleeding and subsequently developed medical complications.

facts.claim: She was shifted to Cheluvamba Hospital in Mysuru with ventilator support, where she was declared dead, her family sources said.
facts.quote: She was shifted to Cheluvamba Hospital in Mysuru with ventilator support, where she was declared dead, her family sources said.

facts.claim: According to Manjunath, both the mother and the newborn were initially doing well.
facts.quote: According to Manjunath, both the mother and the newborn were initially doing well.

facts.claim: Right from the beginning of pregnancy, Sheelavathi’s medical report was normal
facts.quote: Right from the beginning of pregnancy, Sheelavathi’s medical report was normal

facts.claim: Manjunath said, accusing the hospital of negligence.
facts.quote: Manjunath said, accusing the hospital of negligence.

facts.claim: Sheelavathi was alive until we reached Cheluvamba Hospital in Mysuru only because she was on ventilator support. By the time we reached the hospital, she was in a critical condition. However, the medical consultants at the taluk hospital tried to convince me that nothing serious had happened while she was there

facts.claim: This is the second delivery death reported within a month at Maternal and Child Health Hospital in K.R. Nagar, according to sources.
facts.quote: This is the second delivery death reported within a month at Maternal and Child Health Hospital in K.R. Nagar, according to sources.

facts.claim: When contacted, sources in the hospital said, "Sheelavathi’s case is suspected to be a case of embolism. It is a rare occurrence. We are awaiting the postmortem report from Cheluvamba Hospital"
